meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索历史记忆，找出之前会话的解法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从过往会话中找回解法与结论
copy.tagline_en: Search past sessions for prior solutions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to dig up past session solutions and decisions

howto.what: 能够搜索并提取过往会话中保存的工作记录,先给出带编号的摘要列表,再按需查看时间线,最后只取需要的完整记录。
howto.when: 当你问起之前是否做过某件事、上次怎么做的,或需要用到过去会话的内容时。

say.text: 我们之前是不是解决过 JWT 超时的问题?
say.note: 会先搜索相关记录,返回编号列表。

say.text: 查一下上周修过哪些 bug。
say.note: 按类型和时间筛选,给出相关摘要。

say.text: 看看 #11131 周围的上下文。
say.note: 会拉取该 ID 前后的时间线。

howto.what_en: Searches the persistent cross-session memory, first returning a compact indexed list of matching records, then can show a timeline around relevant items, and finally fetches full details only for selected IDs.
howto.when_en: When you ask about previous sessions, e.g., whether something was already solved, how something was done last time, or need work from earlier conversations.

say_en.text: Did we already fix the JWT timeout issue before?
Which bugs did we fix last week?
say_en.note: Filters by type and time to show summaries.
